name: Horizon
quote: To build a comfortable nook for a nap in the bustling clamor of the city.

voices.label: Good Morning
voices.text: I heard that in the past, artists would wait at the ports at dawn to capture the scenery of the sunlight dancing upon the waves. Just thinking about the lovely colors you could see there banishes all desire to sleep...

voices.label: Good Afternoon
voices.text: Hm... hm... hm? Professor, did you say something just now?

voices.label: Good Evening
voices.text: Riddle time. It is ruddy red at times, shining gold at others, purple and yellow at turns, and also half-gray, half-white... What do you think it is, Professor?

voices.label: Good Night
voices.text: I'm so sleepy... I can barely make out colors anymore. Goodnight, Professor.

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 1
voices.text: You want a multicolored white? Oh... I get it now. I'll prepare it for you right away.

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 2
voices.text: You want to know why I carry a brush with me? Oh, so I can use it at any time. It looks weird? Oh...

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 3
voices.text: Hm... hm... ah. Sorry, Professor, I was distracted just now... huh? So the Professor wasn't there...?

voices.label: Home Screen 5
voices.text: This is the new theme I designed for the dorms. Come take a look.

voices.label: Interactive Voice 1
voices.text: Blue... Do you like this color, Professor?

voices.label: Interactive Voice 2
voices.text: Careful... Colors like this don't wash out easily.

voices.label: Interactive Voice 3
voices.text: It feels strange...

voices.label: On Duty
voices.text: So all I need to do is stand here?

voices.label: Obtain
voices.text: Your color is a good match for my clothes today... Ah, I'm Horizon, the color of the sky.

voices.label: Potential Breakthrough
voices.text: Good, coloring complete.

voices.label: Neural Expansion
voices.text: Now I've got another color.

voices.label: Max Rank
voices.text: I can almost see it... it's a color I've never seen before.

voices.label: Join Team
voices.text: Is there another request?

voices.label: Battle Start
voices.text: Let's get to work, then.

voices.label: Ultimate Skill
voices.text: It's decided, then... I'll go with this color!

voices.label: MVP 1
voices.text: Please don't touch the paint before it dries.

voices.label: MVP 2
voices.text: Hm... What color should I use next...

voices.label: Defeat
voices.text: I can't... see anything...

voices.label: Oath
voices.text: If I had to define you as a color, what would it be, Professor? I've pondered that question many times before, but you keep showing me new colors before I can find an answer... Perhaps I'll have to spend a long, long time, long enough for me to fade to gray, before I can find the answer. Still, that's alright, because you'll be by my side until then. Won't you, Professor?

voices.label: New Year
voices.text: Happy New Year, Professor. Everyone is celebrating the New Year, so let's do something too. How about, say, repainting the entire Oasis... Hm? We don't need to go that far? Then... at the very least, let's do your room...

voices.label: Valentine's Day
voices.text: So it's a tradition to eat chocolate today? I thought it was because everyone liked it. Huh, so they don't eat it themselves but give it to you? I wonder why?

voices.label: Tanabata
voices.text: I heard that everyone's busy building a "magpie bridge" today, so I mixed up a batch of light pink and pearly white paint. Hehehe, don't look so shocked. I know magpies aren't that color, but according to my design... Hm? The "magpie bridge" isn't a real bridge?

voices.label: Halloween
voices.text: All these crosses and coffins... Do you like this sort of decor? It's not exactly my style, but I can help change all the dorms to match... You only like them like this for today? I don't get it...

voices.label: Christmas
voices.text: Look, Professor, this is the "turkey" I made for you. More vibrant oranges like these are a little hard for me to handle, but I did my best to blend them. As a wall color, it's... Huh? You wanted an edible turkey?

voices.label: Birthday Wish
voices.text: Happy birthday, Professor. I'm not sure what sort of gift you wanted, so I did a cubist portrait of you... Ah, please don't open it right away; it's kind of embarrassing.

voices.label: Neural Cloud
voices.text: Neural Cloud

voices.label: Intimacy 1
voices.text: Your room is the place where you can relax most easily. Therefore, looking at a person's interior design requirements is like peeking into their soul. In order to live up to the trust that their souls have placed in me, I must select the most ideal colors and designs to help each and every homeowner build a refuge for their hearts.

voices.label: Intimacy 2
voices.text:
After observing the Oasis for a while, I get the feeling that everyone is used to life here. 
Do you want to know how I know that? You can tell from their room designs. You can see an owner's personality in the aesthetics and practicality of their rooms... And I can see a foundation of "home" in everybody's rooms. 
This is quite surprising, Professor. How did you convince everyone to open their hearts? If I had that ability too, I'm sure work would go much more smoothly for me...

voices.label: Intimacy 3
voices.text:
Banxsy, hm... I know her, yes. She has a very famous style, and she stands out a lot. She's always used a very special color palette. I once tried to imitate her artistic style and color selection during my interior design work, but it ended in failure. I've always wanted to ask her how she became so sensitive to colors... 
Hm? You're advising me to ask her in person? Uh... wha?! You mean, you can do that...

voices.label: Intimacy 4
voices.text:
Sorry to keep you waiting. This is the new plan for your bedroom. I did my best to imbue it with the impression I got of you, and I hope you're happy with it, Professor. 
Speaking of which, I never expected the day would come when you'd entrust me with such an important task. Do you remember what I said before? Analyzing design requirements is like analyzing a homeowner's heart. Both you and the others are willing to open your hearts to me and convey your feelings to me with your words and actions. I'm sure that in my case, I wouldn't be able to do it... 
Huh? I'm telling you how I feel right now? Eh... eh...? Ehhhhh? Ehhhhhhhhhhhhh?

voices.label: Intimacy 5
voices.text:
All this time, I've been relying on the use of colors to convey my thoughts. To me, words and actions are like fragile bubbles; they pop and vanish before they can be spoken or performed, leaving nothing but abstract blobs of pigment. But one day, you appeared among those pigments, Professor... You were the one who pieced together the colors of my heart again, turned them into a portrait, and then showed them to me.
If I continue to keep you company, perhaps I might be able to share the colors hidden in my heart with more people someday... Don't you agree, Professor?

career:
Working in conjunction with many high-end artistic and design educational institutions across the globe, the UA-ID is a project helmed by Universal Anything Services, targeted at producing commercial Dolls for use in the field of modern interior design. This project's aim is to overcome the limitations of human beings in the development of artistic aesthetics, as well as attempt to integrate art styles from different regional cultures and consumer classes in order to deliver an iterative series of outputs and provide a variety of solutions to improve the quality of life for different grades of users. Horizon is a second-generation product of the UA-ID project, and in addition to her artistic design modules, she has also been equipped with basic primary industrial processing abilities. This helps Horizon demonstrate the practical effects of design that can be used for reference and avoids the issue of first-generation UA-ID Dolls producing designs that are too detached from reality.
 
After producing many well-received design plans during her testing phase, Horizon was selected to join Project Neural Cloud as a representative of interior design Dolls.
infoStories:
As the product of a multi-disciplinary collaboration between UAS and many other fields, the UA-ID development project received a lot of attention from the moment it was founded. The first generation of UA-IDs was known for its very high specs; not only did the designers develop 3D structural scanning abilities for their bodies, they also equipped their neural clouds with customized 3D graphical simulation modules along with a multi-core processing system to meet the needs of high-speed deconstruction. On top of that, the first-gen UA-ID's neural cloud was preloaded with vast quantities of design and other related information, giving it tremendous deep learning abilities with respect to various design styles. 

However, contrary to UAS's extremely high expectations, despite possessing excellent design abilities and aesthetic standards, the first-gen UA-IDs were lacking in the ability to practically apply them, with many of their interior design plans being severely divorced from reality which caused many of their designs to remain on paper despite their great potential. It was against this backdrop that the second-gen UA-ID was born, an improved version of the UA-ID with improved bodily robustness, additional decoration knowledge, and on-site construction capabilities.

During its testing phase, the second-gen UA-IDs demonstrated design abilities that were superior to those of the first generation. More satisfying was the fact that the designs produced by the second-gen units were much more practicable. Due to their excellent physical abilities and interior decoration knowledge, the second-gen UA-IDs could even temporarily substitute as workers and equipment on the worksite and work independently to ensure the project continued moving along. This breakthrough received rave reviews from the industry, and the UA-ID line was hailed as one of UAS's 10 best Doll lines of that year. 

As one of the most outstanding second-gen UA-IDs, Horizon not only possessed a greater degree of contemplation and obsession with interior design, but she also had a unique insight and interpretation towards the study of color. She was keenly aware of the individual variances between her various owners, and used her impression of them as the color schemes for her interior design plans. This was supplemented by her internal calculation and powerful design abilities, which allowed her to consistently design eye-catching plans that adhered to their original principles and ensured that they get implemented.

While she was still in the testing phase and Horizon was learning to mesh with her various employers, she developed the idea that interior design was a projection of the customer's heart. After being committed to commercial operational testing, her works became more humanized and followed each customer's needs with greater precision, resulting in excellent reviews from the market.

"This is my house. It was made for me and me alone! It's better than I expected; it's so perfect I can't even think of any way to improve it!"
—From a client after receiving a design plan.

However, there were several small complaints from clients about interacting with Horizon during the testing phase. Perhaps it was because too much of her neural cloud space was given over to interior decoration and design, but Horizon was even more reserved and reticent than others in the UA-ID series. To others, she appeared to be a weirdo who spent all day engrossed in design and renovation. However, those comments were outweighed by the many more rave reviews about her great design abilities and achievements, as well as her highly accurate and effective conclusions following just a single interaction.

As the external trials neared their end, Horizon was selected for Project Neural Cloud as an example of an interior design Doll.

When Horizon first arrived at the Oasis, she was entranced by its interior design and often lost herself in touring its halls. Occasionally, she would take notes and write down the things that inspired her, highlighting which objects were beautiful and practical, as well as experiencing how seemingly insignificant details could reflect their owner's personality.

Soon after that, Horizon took over the important work for festival design and construction. During this process, Horizon met with many setbacks, but she managed to successfully complete her assignments despite the worries of others. Meanwhile, her generosity, attention to detail, and sheer working ability earned her a good reputation in the Oasis.

However, she realized too late that she had become too immersed in design work, and her image in the eyes of others was one of a reticent designer who disliked interacting with others. While this did not affect her design work or the others' acceptance of her, it seemed like the barrier to her communicating with others had become even higher. That said, she simply regarded the matter as a tradeoff of sorts and calmly continued her daily routine.

When Horizon first encountered Banxsy's unscrubbed graffiti, she immediately recognized it as coming from the hands of a Doll artist she liked in reality, but her poor speaking skills meant that she never once thought of talking directly to Banxsy and asking her about her art style. Instead, she buried herself in designing, hoping to approach her in terms of style and color control. This lasted until she began talking to Banxsy with the help of the other Oasis Dolls.

"Huh? You're... You're Banxsy? Ac-actually, I'm a big fan of your work..."

Although she still didn't interact much with the others, Horizon managed to blend into the Oasis and integrate her design concepts into the Oasis' style to create works that were different from what she produced in reality. As someone who preferred to express herself through tones rather than words, the portrait of her heart will surely be conveyed to more and more people through her colors.
oathDesc: Become the brightest splash of color in her elegant life.

projections.name: Unbound Origin
projections.desc:
Attire produced with Neural Cloud Projection upon a Doll's arrival in Magrasea. These are the clothes they are most comfortable in.
"People have never longed for breathtaking intricacy. Telling the difference between what they want and what they need is my job."

projections.name: Framework of the Heart
projections.desc:
Attire and environment produced with Neural Cloud Projection upon a Doll's arrival in Magrasea, which mirrors their life in the real world.
"Her office environment is extremely plain, in contrast to her works. Just like a blank canvas before a painter sets brush to it, it contains infinite potential."
